messages:
Leah: Quick sync — we need to lock the seller-role mapping and governance checklist for the publisher activation across AWS/GCP/Azure. Goal: have legal signoff + terra/credentials playbook by EOW.
Ravi: Thanks. Do we have a canonical mapping for 'publisher-admin' vs 'billing-operator' scopes? Contract language will reference them.
Jordan: Not yet. Product wants a simple three-role model: Owner, Billing, ReadOnly. Can we map to cloud roles? Anya: I'll draft mapping. AWS -> IAM role, GCP -> service account roles, Azure -> RBAC role assignment. 
Tom: Also need to confirm who can rotate AMI/VM images (that's Owner?) and who can publish SKU changes. 
Leah: Yes - Owner should be able to push SKU updates. Billing-operator limited to metering and trial toggles. ReadOnly can't touch assets.
Ravi: Ok, for contracts we'll call them: PublisherAdmin, PublisherBilling, PublisherViewer. I'll update the clause referencing 'publisher-managed artifacts' and add rotation SLA.
Anya: Draft mapping (quick):
```text
AWS: PublisherAdmin -> iam:PassRole, ec2:ModifyImage, marketplace:Publish
     PublisherBilling -> marketplace:ManageBilling, billing:GetUsage
GCP: PublisherAdmin -> roles/compute.admin, roles/iam.serviceAccountUser
     PublisherBilling -> roles/billing.user
Azure: PublisherAdmin -> Contributor + custom action 'Marketplace/Publish'
     PublisherBilling -> Billing Reader + 'Marketplace/Manage'
```
Leah: perfect. Jordan: can we add this to the publisher onboarding playbook as a step with checklist items for each cloud? 
Jordan: yes — I'll add a 'Roles & Access' page and a 'Credentialing' step. Can someone drop the terraform snippet for initial role bootstrapping?
Anya: putting a minimal Terraform example here for AWS role binding:
```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "pub_admin" {
  name = "publisher_admin_${var.publisher_id}"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.assume_role.json
}
```
Tom: also note: marketing assets + logo licensing need legal approval before listing goes live. @Ravi can you confirm the EULA addendum language for marketplace display? :eyes:
Ravi: I'll add a short addendum that covers brand usage and liability caps for marketplace assets. ETA EOD tomorrow.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: Marketplace onboarding form submitted for publisher-123. Status: docs incomplete (logos missing). 
Leah: Action items: 1) Ravi to finalize addendum (EOD tomorrow). 2) Anya to upload role mapping doc to /confluence/publishers (today). 3) Jordan to add 'Roles & Access' page (this afternoon). 4) Tom to collect AMI IDs and logo files (by Wed). I'll chase dependencies with the publisher contact after lunch. 
Tom: noted. I'll DM the publisher for AMI list. 
Jordan: I'll stub the playbook page and ping design for asset sizing. 
Leah: Thanks all — please emoji react when done :thumbsup:
